query: How can I file a complaint about a government hospital worker demanding bribes?
reference_answer:
Reporting Bribery Demands:
To report bribery demands by a government hospital staff, contact the Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Department (DVAC) or the local police station. You can also call the toll-free helpline 1064 or file a complaint online on the TN Government website.
answer: To file a complaint about a government hospital worker demanding bribes, first report the incident to the hospital's internal complaints department. Then, contact the local health inspector or the relevant government department for further action. [Document 1]
